label: Early copy phase (outputting original tokens 1-2), token-modulated
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never during original tokens or on the <DEL> step), concentrated on the first two copy steps after <DEL> (recall_idx 1 and 2 hold ~86% of activation mass; recall_idx 3 adds ~10%), with a small secondary bump on the last outputs of long sequences. Within those steps it is sparse (~18% fire), and whether/how strongly it fires depends on which tokens are being output and coming next: output tokens f, z, n, l, 0, h and next outputs n, a, s, v raise the rate 3-6x, and the top activations are sequences like "x z n a ..." outputting z/n just before n/a. No clean token rule was found (token-set predicates reach F1 ~0.40 at most). Does not fire on first occurrences of a token, on original-phase inputs, or on the delimiter step.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the token being output (most: f, z, n, h, l, 0; least: d, v, -, t) and the next token to output (most: n, a, s, v, q, f; least: h, 2, -, 3); timing cues that raise it most: phase=2, recall_idx=2, recall_idx=1.
